spans.s: (L. also n.; ifc. f(आ). ; of doubtful derivation) a hoof (esp. the hoof of a horse), RV. &c. &c.
an eighth (because of the divided hoofs of the cow; cf. पाद, a fourth), RV.; TS.; ŚBr.
a claw, VS. xii, 4
a wooden implement formed like a claw or hook (for lifting an iron pot or pan from the fire), Br.; Lāṭy.
Unguis Odoratus, L.
(du., with वसिष्ठस्य) N. of two Sāmans, KātyŚr.
the root of a tree, L.

etym.s: [cf. accord. to some, Germ. huof, Huf; Angl.Sax. hôf; Eng. hoof]

spans.s: together with the sound or letter फ् (-त्व n.), TāṇḍBr.
N. of various men, ĀrṣBr.
N. of various Sāmans, (-त्व n.), ib. &c.
शफ—ग्रह॑ m. the hoof or claw of an animal used as a kind of receptacle, ŚBr.
शफ॑—च्युत (शफ॑-), mfn. tossed up by hoofs (as dust), RV.
1. शफ॑—वत् (शफ॑-), mfn. possessing hoofs or claws (n. a hoofed animal), ib.
2. शफ—वत् ind. like a hoof, MW.
शफ—शस् ind. by eighths (see शफ above), PañcavBr.
N. of a man (cf. शाफाक्षि).
destroying hoofs or d˚ with the hoofs (said of demons), RV.
mf(ऊ)n. (a woman) whose thighs resemble the two divisions of a cow's hoof, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 70.
(ifc. f(आ). ; also written सफर and said to be connected with शफ) Cyprinus Saphore (a kind of bright little fish that glistens when darting about in shallow water), Kāv.; VarBṛS.; Kathās. &c.
a carp or kind of large fish (that preys on other fish), Kathās. cxxiii, 10
See शफर.
a fish or a kind of fish (see पूति-श्˚)
ebony, L.
(prob.) m. a small fish, Gal.
शफर—रूप n. the form of a carp or large fish, BhP.
the fish Clupea Alosa (= इल्लिश), L.
g. उत्करादि.
a box, box-like receptacle, pot, Hcar.
a fisherman, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 35, Sch.
patr. fr. शफाक्ष, Pravar.
N. of a school of the Yajur-veda (cf. शापेय).
स-फ—त्व n.
स-फ—त्व n.
mf(आ)n. together with fruits, having or bearing fruit or seed, fruitful (as a tree), PārGṛ.; MBh.; Kathās.
‘having seed’ i.e. possessing testicles, not emasculated, R.
having good results, productive, profitable, successful (with √ कृ, ‘to fulfil’, ‘keep a promise’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
together with the result, VarBṛS.
स-फल—त्व n. profitableness, successfulness, Śiś.; Kathās.; Sāh.
स-फल—प्रार्थन mfn. one whose desire is fulfilled, Vikr.
स-फ˚लोदय m. ‘one whose appearance brings good results’, N. of Śiva, MBh.
स-फ˚लोदर्क mfn. bearing fruit in the future, promising success, Mālatīm.
furnished with a shield, MBh.
Nom. P. ˚यति, to make profitable or successful, derive advantage from, enjoy, Kāv.; Kathās.
in comp. for सफल.
सफली—करण n. the act of making successful, KāśīKh.
सफली—√ कृ P. -करोति = सफलय, Pañcat.; Śatr.
सफली—कृत mfn. made profitable or useful, Kāv.; Kathās.
fulfilled, accomplished, R.
सफली—√ भू P. -भवति, to be successful, yield profit, Subh.
सफली—भूत mfn. become profitable or advantageous.
having foam, foamy, frothy, VarBṛS.
स-फेन—पुञ्ज mfn. covered with dense masses of foam (as the ocean), Kum.
fruitfulness, profitableness, advantage, result, success, Mn.; MBh. &c.
